dog.description_text:
This pet needs emergency placement. Please click here to go to our emergency placement page for more information.

This pet is available only through ACC New Hope partners. To adopt or foster, please complete the pre-screener form below. Inquiries sent directly to ACC will not receive a response.

Pre-Screener Form

Fenix is on the at-risk list due to behavior concerns. In the prior home, Fenix was reported to have increased anxiety and a history of multiple minor bite incidents over the past two years, primarily when startled or being picked up. The bites were described as brief nip-and-release incidents that caused minor injuries. Fenix also has escalated to trying to bite at staff and allows minimal handling. Fenix's previous owners state there favorite thing is he likes to lay and cuddle on your lap Medically, Fenix is dental disease but otherwise healthy at this time.

Fenix was surrendered due to behavior concerns in the previous home. Fenix's previous family reported that he is not picky with food, likes to lie and cuddle in laps, and prefers to be in rooms where there are people when it's quiet. He is reported to have multiple bites in the previous home as a result of being startled or picked up. During his stay in care, Fenix has been fearful and difficult to remove from the kennel. Due to the concerns reported in the previous home, the behavior department recommends that Fenix be placed with a New Hope placement partner who can provide an experienced adult-only foster home that can provide him with a period of decompression and allow Fenix to acclimate comfortably to his new environment; force-free, reward-based training only is advised.
